description: This Dart source file defines classes responsible for initializing application dependencies and bootstrapping the application. It sets up caching, repositories, database, and download engine components.

classes.name: AppDependencies
classes.description: A class that encapsulates core services and repositories that the application requires, including caching, data repositories, database, and download engine.

classes.name: AppBootstrap
classes.description: A class providing a static method to initialize and assemble application dependencies asynchronously.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: A static asynchronous method that initializes shared preferences, cache, database, repositories, and download engine, then returns an instance of AppDependencies.
